facts.subject: kestrel bay
facts.fact: Kestrel Bay is a present-day coastal city where about one person in fifty has a power; powers are registered with the city's Registry Office.

facts.subject: unregistered use
facts.fact: Unregistered use of a power is a fine, not a crime.

facts.subject: tone
facts.fact: Grounded, warm, a little noir; low lethality. Nobody dies in this campaign.

facts.subject: last train
facts.fact: The 23:45 last train on Line 9 is held because the signal box shorted at 23:31 on Day 1 (Friday).

facts.subject: tib
facts.fact: Tib is Tobias Achterberg, a courier carrying a locked aluminium case. Always the full name on first mention in a scene.

facts.subject: june
facts.fact: June Halloway plays a theremin in the concourse. She knows a scared boy is in the tunnel; she does not know what the static is.

facts.subject: harrow street
facts.fact: Line 9 ends at Harrow Street Depot (loading bay and night office).
